use_cases.title: Inspect concentration without inventing a rate

body.t: Load a CSV with latitude and longitude to display a point-concentration heatmap. Each point has equal weight and a 28-pixel influence radius in the rendered layer. Change zoom to inspect the pattern, but do not read the colours as a population, safety or area-normalized rate.

Add several rows near one coordinate and a separate isolated row. The nearby group should produce stronger heat than the isolated row at the same zoom. Changing the zoom changes the screen-space density; keep zoom fixed for visual comparisons.
